OpenCode GTK 0.1.0 - Linux x86_64

Runtime dependencies: GTK 4.6 or newer, libdbus, glibc 2.34 or newer,
and a Secret Service provider such as GNOME Keyring or KWallet.

Debian/Ubuntu:
  sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libgtk-4-1

Fedora:
  sudo dnf install gtk4

Arch Linux:
  sudo pacman -S gtk4

Start the client:
  ./opencode-gtk

Use Settings in the app to choose the server, username, password,
Cloudflare Access service token, and theme.
The default server is http://127.0.0.1:4096.

Run against an authenticated HTTPS server:
  OPENCODE_SERVER_URL=https://opencode.example.com \
  OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME=opencode \
  OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD='your-password' \
  ./opencode-gtk

Remote cleartext HTTP is intentionally rejected. Loopback HTTP is allowed.
